name: andthen
description: Small habits, linked to what you already do.

scripts.test: npm test -w @andthen/core && npm test -w @andthen/data && npm test -w @andthen/api && npm test -w @andthen/web -- --watch=false && npm test -w @andthen/extension -- --watch=false
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @andthen/core && npm run typecheck -w @andthen/data && npm run typecheck -w @andthen/api
scripts.package:extension: npm run build:extension && npm run package -w @andthen/extension
